## Definition of Done (docs/method.md)

- [ ] The story is 👍 Approved and its planning doc was committed first
- [ ] Red first: the failing test or check came before the change
- [ ] `make verify` green, output seen
- [ ] Docs updated in the same change; Accepted ADRs superseded, not edited
- [ ] Adversarial `/code-review` run; findings fixed or filed as stories
